record.title: DTC nominee registered-holder route
record.sub: Hold the claim or registered title
kv: SEC staff guidance states that Cede & Co. appears as sole registered owner on the shareholder list for securities deposited with DTC by DTC participants.
A security is deposited with DTC and the issuer or its transfer agent maintains the shareholder list showing DTC's nominee.
DTC nominee for securities deposited with DTC

Identify the particular security and confirm that it is deposited with DTC. Recover the applicable issuer or transfer-agent shareholder list or equivalent record. Keep the DTC nominee position separate from DTC participants and their customers' beneficial interests.

This route establishes a registered nominee category only. It does not establish ownership by a participant or customer, securities entitlement, voting authority, or a particular token ledger's legal effect.
Cede & Co. (DTC nominee): SEC staff guidance says Cede & Co., DTC's nominee, appears on the shareholder list as sole registered owner of securities deposited with DTC by DTC participants.

Cede & Co. (DTC nominee): DTC nominee and sole registered owner for a security deposited with DTC. SEC staff guidance identifies Cede & Co. in that capacity, subject to the particular security being deposited with DTC.
